title: Which numbers are two squares?
title_zh: 哪些数是两个平方之和
summary: Up to fifty, the numbers that are a sum of two squares look scattered. Give the numbers a second direction, so that they live on a grid: the point (3, 2) is 3 + 2i, and multiplying it by its mirror image 3 − 2i cancels the turn and lands on the real line at 3² + 2² = 13, which Lean checks for every grid point. Multiplying grid numbers adds angles and multiplies lengths, so (2 + i)(3 + 2i) = 4 + 7i gives 65 = 4² + 7², and the mirror factor gives 65 = 1² + 8². Lean checks that every prime leaving remainder 1 on division by 4 is a sum of two squares, and that squares leave only 0 or 1, so no sum of two squares leaves 3; the book calls the two kinds plane primes and line primes. Lean checks the full criterion: a number is a sum of two squares exactly when every prime leaving remainder 3 appears to an even power. So 2025 = 3⁴ · 5² = 27² + 36², while 2024 = 2³ · 11 · 23 is not, although it leaves remainder 0. The theorems decide whether a number can be written so; they give no fast search and no count of the ways. How primes split in the Gaussian integers is a literature result, and the names plane and line are the book's reading.
summary_zh: 50 以内能写成两个平方之和的数，看上去零零散散。给数添上第二个方向，让它们住进方格：格点 (3, 2) 就是 3 + 2i，乘以它的镜像 3 − 2i，转角抵消，落回实轴上 3² + 2² = 13；Lean 对每个格点都检验了这一点。方格里的数相乘，角度相加、长度相乘，所以 (2 + i)(3 + 2i) = 4 + 7i 给出 65 = 4² + 7²，换成镜像因子又给出 65 = 1² + 8²。Lean 检验了：除以 4 余 1 的素数都是两平方和；平方除以 4 只余 0 或 1，所以两平方和余不出 3。本书把这两种素数叫面素数与线素数。Lean 还检验了完整判据：一个数是两平方和，当且仅当每个除以 4 余 3 的素数都出现偶数次。于是 2025 = 3⁴ · 5² = 27² + 36²，而 2024 = 2³ · 11 · 23 不是，尽管它除以 4 余 0。这些定理只判定能不能写成，不给快速的找法，也不数有几种拆法；素数在高斯整数中如何分裂是文献结果，“面”与“线”的叫法是本书的诠释。
